name: TD3 + adaptive pessimistic targets
tagline: TD3 with twin-critic target blend that adapts per sample: high disagreement pushes toward min(Q), low disagreement toward mean(Q); actor maximises mean of both critics.

key_hyperparams.name: base_pessimism
key_hyperparams.role: neutral pessimism level when disagreement = EMA

key_hyperparams.name: pessimism_sensitivity
key_hyperparams.role: slope of p w.r.t. normalised disagreement

init_recovers: TD3 (min-target) when p ≡ 1; DDPG-style mean target when p ≡ 0
diff_from_baseline: Replaces TD3's hard min-target with a per-sample disagreement-modulated blend of min and mean critics, and changes actor loss from −Q1 to −½(Q1+Q2).

name: TD3 + value-function EMA penalty
tagline: TD3 with orthogonal initialization, gradient clipping, and an extra critic loss penalising deviation of mean(Q1,Q2) from a slow EMA of recent average Q values.
formula: $$\bar Q=\tfrac12(Q_1+Q_2),\;\bar Q^{ema}\!\leftarrow(1-\alpha)\bar Q^{ema}+\alpha\,\overline{\bar Q},\;\mathcal L_Q=\mathrm{MSE}(Q_1,y)+\mathrm{MSE}(Q_2,y)+\lambda(\bar Q-\bar Q^{ema})^2$$

key_hyperparams.name: EMA α
key_hyperparams.role: EMA update rate for Q baseline

key_hyperparams.name: grad_clip
key_hyperparams.role: max norm for both critic and actor

diff_from_baseline: Adds a scalar EMA-Q drift penalty to TD3's critic loss and turns on grad-clipping plus orthogonal initialisation; actor remains −Q1.

name: Weighted-Double-Q TD3 (WD3)
tagline: TD3 where the target Q is a fixed convex combination of min and max of the twin target critics (75% min, 25% max); actor maximises the mean of both critics.

key_hyperparams.name: target_w
key_hyperparams.role: weight on min vs max in the target Q blend

diff_from_baseline: Replaces TD3's strict min-target with 0.75·min + 0.25·max (Weighted Double-Q learning) and uses a symmetric mean-Q actor loss instead of −Q1.

name: LCB-TD3 + advantage-trust BC + grad explore
tagline: TD3 where target and actor optimise a lower-confidence-bound critic, actor adds an advantage-weighted behaviour-cloning trust term, and exploration adds a one-step LCB-gradient nudge in low-disagreement states.

key_hyperparams.name: actor_uncertainty_coef
key_hyperparams.role: LCB coefficient for actor / explore objective

key_hyperparams.name: grad_explore_coef
key_hyperparams.role: step size of normalised LCB-gradient exploration

key_hyperparams.name: explore_disagreement_limit
key_hyperparams.role: max |Q1−Q2| at which gradient explore fires

init_recovers: TD3 when LCB coefs and BC trust both → 0
diff_from_baseline: Adds (i) lower-confidence-bound critics for both targets and actor objective, (ii) state-adaptive BC trust scaled by sigmoid of advantage, and (iii) low-disagreement-gated normalised-gradient exploration on top of TD3.
